description:
READ-ONLY: list every Odoo instance running on the box - the primary (.deb
    default) plus any extra instances added with instance_add - showing each one's
    systemd service, config file, HTTP/gevent port pair, database, active state and
    the nginx site that fronts it. Use this before instance_add (to see what's there)
    or to find the slug you'd pass to instance_remove.
name: instance_list
